title: Blessings
body:
We ask for His Blessings. It gives us light, takes sadness away, gives refreshment, enjoyment, contentment
and satisfaction to our hearts. Without His Blessings that is impossible. This is why you should ask at every
occasions for His Blessings to make you happy and in peace. If blessings come on you, your dreams will also
be pleasant. If not, they will be full of wolves, snakes, dragons and bad things. It is important to be said that
all prophets came to advise mankind and to put them on the right way. Mostly people are running in the
wrong direction and finally this will make them repent. Like on the motor way there are no U-turns. You have
to wait until you come to an exit. On the motor way you may lose half an hour, but what about your life? You
are only given one chance.
- 01.01.1997
